name: Cable Stability Ball Incline Fly
steps: Grip handles from two low pulleys, sit on a stability ball, and walk forward until your upper back reclines at an incline.
Plant your feet wide and hold both handles above your upper chest with palms facing each other.
Open your arms in wide arcs until your upper arms line up with your torso.
Sweep both handles back together above your upper chest, squeezing your pecs briefly at the top.
tips: Maintain a soft bend in each elbow and keep your hips still.
Stop opening your arms before your shoulders roll forward or your torso shifts off the ball.
